successCriteria.description: All five occurrences of `z.date()` in `src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts` are replaced with `z.coerce.date()` — specifically: `startDate` and `endDate` in `createLeaveRequestSchema` (lines 60-61), `startDate` and `endDate` in `updateLeaveRequestSchema` (lines 74-75), and `approvedAt` in `updateLeaveRequestSchema` (line 85).
`createLeaveRequestSchema` accepts ISO 8601 date strings (e.g. `"2025-06-01"`) for `startDate` and `endDate` and coerces them to `Date` objects, while still accepting native `Date` objects.

`updateLeaveRequestSchema` accepts ISO 8601 date strings for `startDate`, `endDate`, and `approvedAt` and coerces them to `Date` objects, while still accepting native `Date` objects and respecting the `.optional()` / `.nullable()` modifiers.

constraints: The `.refine()` on `createLeaveRequestSchema` that enforces `startDate <= endDate` must continue to work correctly — `z.coerce.date()` produces `Date` objects, so the comparison logic is unchanged.
No other Zod schema in the codebase is affected — only the five `z.date()` calls in `src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts` are changed.
outOfScope: Changes to the `LeaveRequest` entity interface or `CreateLeaveRequestDto` interface — these already type date fields as `Date` and remain correct.

entityInvariants.invariant: The `createLeaveRequestSchema` and `updateLeaveRequestSchema` must accept ISO 8601 date strings from JSON request bodies and coerce them to `Date` objects, satisfying GP-003 (input validation at API boundaries) without rejecting valid HTTP payloads.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The coerced `Date` objects produced by `z.coerce.date()` must be compatible with the `LeaveRequest` entity interface and `CreateLeaveRequestDto` interface, both of which type `startDate`, `endDate`, and `approvedAt` as `Date`.

The `.refine()` validation `startDate <= endDate` must continue to pass when both fields are provided as ISO strings (e.g. `"2025-06-01"` and `"2025-06-05"`) and fail when `startDate` is after `endDate`.
